biggest_gap: When the wanted text is an older clip or a fragment buried in a longer clip (an email, phone or salary out of a copied message), side A made the person take the slow route: open Spotlight clipboard history, scroll/type a search word (type:http, type:engi) and press Return, or paste the whole thing and trim x4. That cost 4.2-6.7 s per step versus B's 2.2-3.7 s, and in step 21 the hotkey also made the person wait 476 ms and still trim x4 by hand (4.86 s vs 2.75 s). The extract was not done for the person.
notes: 33 of 46 steps are a plain cmd-V on both sides, so the comparison hinges on 13 steps.
